svg.title: Current C4: parallel spatial and macro–micro temporal encoding with prediction-level MoE
svg.desc: One global dynamic four-expert router per sample, shared across horizons; one shared forecast head. Macro memory H drives regime filtering and recurrent microstates Z. Learned global A0 feeds two original graph blocks. No D0B gate, no task router, no new graph mechanism.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

svg.text: C4 · 全局动态时空预测混合专家模型
